2026-09-02 22:05:16.986 |   a requirement dependency on it.
2026-09-02 22:05:16.986 | • A unit may be started when needed via activation (socket, path, timer,
2026-09-02 22:05:16.986 |   D-Bus, udev, scripted systemctl call, ...).
